name: Mujintou Monogatari R
source:
As the story goes, the main character is working as a part-time tutor and he gets rewarded for his efforts with a island vacation. Unfortunately, some shortsightedness leads to him and his friends being stranded and needing to survive until help/rescue arrives.

[From [url=https://ontlogy.wordpress.com/2014/02/06/datingsimonth-looking-at-mujintou-monogatari-r-for-the-sega-saturn/]ontlogy.wordpress[/url]]
translation:
故事中，主角是一名兼职家教，因工作努力获得了一次岛屿度假作为奖励。不幸的是，由于一些疏忽，他和朋友们被困在了岛上，需要在救援到来之前想办法生存下去。

[出自[url=https://ontlogy.wordpress.com/2014/02/06/datingsimonth-looking-at-mujintou-monogatari-r-for-the-sega-saturn/]ontlogy.wordpress[/url]]
